rotation.note: Unattended run: FULL books keyword set used (3 core + all 22 flat keywords = 25 working keywords), not a date-rotated slice. Date (day-of-month 18) is still used for EMPHASIS ordering only: 18 mod 22 = 18 -> the query list leads with the later half of the flat list (AI manuscript / AI comic manga / AI textbook / AI copyright authors / AI book recommendation) so under-covered tail keywords get first-pass budget, while heavily-covered copyright-litigation angles are pushed to the back.

retrieval_hint.why: Plain `site:` WebSearch returns stale evergreen pages for these outlets; the published_time gate then kills most of them. Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items whose pubDate is inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then run the WebSearch queries below to fill gaps.
retrieval_hint.youtube_feed_pattern: https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<UC...> — resolve channel_id by fetching https://www.youtube.com/@<handle> and reading `channelId` / `og:url` in the HTML.
retrieval_hint.paywall_note: thebookseller.com, publishersweekly.com and janefriedman.com premium posts are frequently teaser-only. Keep them as candidates (headline + dek + published_time are verifiable) but flag mode=summary.
